Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, one of Japan's leading financial institutions, has partnered with Morrison as its preferred global infrastructure manager and holds a 15% stake in Morrison, which gives us a strong platform in the Japanese market. Our investments serve enduring societal needs, including energy transition, digital connectivity, mobility, ageing populations and the circular economy. We are a global firm with a local approach and a one-team culture. We are now looking for an Investment Director to help shape our growth in Japan and across Asia. Your responsibilities will include, but not be limited to: Originate and lead transactions: build and prioritise the pipeline, run the deal process, make the key tactical decisions and lead negotiations with vendors. Own the investment case: take full responsibility for the risk/return profile, lead due diligence priorities and present your recommendations to the Investment Committee. Structure equity and debt: lead discussions with co-investors, governance and shareholder agreements, and management incentive arrangements. You will also direct leverage strategy and bank negotiations. Drive portfolio value: serve as a Board Director, execute the investment thesis, help shape company strategy and lead CEO appointments. Represent Morrison: maintain senior relationships with corporates, banks and advisors, and speak at industry events. About You You are an Investment Director or equivalent with: 7+ years' experience in infrastructure or private equity, ideally in heavy industrial or capital-intensive sectors.
